note: Additive V34.1 layout templates for the existing F33 Design System routes. Application Shell and Content Layout are separate identities. All examples are generic Core patterns with synthetic content; no business module, backend or real write. Preview widths are simulated in an in-page container-scoped stage.

application-shell.description: Application chrome: primary rail, context sidebar, top bar or top navigation, workspace toolbar and assistant sidebar.

content-layout.description: The page inside the shell: page header, toolbar, content, split panes, inspector and footer.

template.description: Layout template id from this registry.

viewport.description: Simulated preview width in CSS pixels. Preview setting only.

theme.description: Preview theme through existing semantic tokens. Preview setting only.

contextSidebar.description: Context navigation sidebar. Locked by some templates.

pageHeader.description: Page header slot inside the content layout.

toolbar.description: Toolbar slot inside the content layout.

footer.description: Page footer slot inside the content layout.

aiAssistant.description: Assistant sidebar slot. Locked off by Public Layout.

inspectorPanel.description: Properties inspector slot. Used by Fullscreen and Inspector layouts.

contentWidth.description: Content measure inside the frame: fluid, 960 px standard, or 680 px narrow.

normalization: Locked fields are overwritten with the template value and reported in warnings.
viewport and theme are preview settings and do not change the layout structure.
Export always contains the normalized effective configuration, never sample content.
